roles: Existing four training users and one validation user per source trajectory; held diagnostic user excluded; users1/2 never accessed as signal
aggregation: class macro within each observed user, then user macro; absent HV6 class3 excluded, never imputed; CE computed float64
purpose: Distinguish persistent observed training-group underfit from source-validation generalization gap before naive group-loss reweighting
decision: If gate fails do not launch unregularized group-DRO based solely on hard training-user hypothesis. Failure does not reject regularized group DRO or all robust optimization. Gate passing is only permission to design a separate matched control, not accuracy gain.
limits: No target score or checkpoint selection
No attribution to spurious correlation without controlled evidence
Class-macro normalization is diagnostic, not identical to official group-DRO training objective
Fixed endpoint segment averages differ from train-mode dropout losses
Source validation has research history; not external validation
Known literature mechanism, not novel algorithm
